I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land / servitude right described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act. Column 11 described the land from which the servitude in acquired.

I. Described Acquisition of servitude right over a 5 meters wide road of the laying of Owitiyawatta Wastewater Pipe Line under Negombo Wastewater Management project. II. Land described as following name and extent depicted in The Advance Tracing No. GA/NEG/2021/536 dated 04.04.2022 prepared by the Survey or General, situated in the Village of Ovitiyawatta, in Pallansena North Grama Niladhari Division, No. 77, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Negombo, in Gampaha District, Western Province and bounded as follows.
01. Lot A – Name of the land can to be found - Extent: 0.0599 Hectare
North: Land claimed by K.L.C.A. Perera ;East: Land claimed by K.L.C.A. Perera; South: Land claimed by K.L.C.A. Perera; West: Road and Land claimed by K.L.C.A. Perera ;
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/18/2021/WS/129.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.28th May, 2024.
